name: SaaS and developer tools
description: Subscription software, APIs, and technical products.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ARR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Contracted subscription revenue normalized to a yearly figure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MRR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Contracted subscription revenue normalized to a monthly figure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: churn
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of customers or revenue lost in a period.

hasDefinedTerm.name: net revenue retention
hasDefinedTerm.description: Revenue from existing customers this period versus last, including expansion and churn. Above 100% means growth without new logos.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PQL
hasDefinedTerm.description: A user whose product usage signals readiness to buy, as opposed to one who filled in a form.

hasDefinedTerm.name: product-led growth
hasDefinedTerm.description: Acquiring and expanding customers through the product itself rather than through a sales motion.

hasDefinedTerm.name: free trial
hasDefinedTerm.description: Time-limited full access used to demonstrate value before purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: freemium
hasDefinedTerm.description: A permanently free tier with paid upgrades, as distinct from a time-limited trial.

hasDefinedTerm.name: activation
hasDefinedTerm.description: The point where a new user first reaches meaningful value. The metric that most predicts retention.

hasDefinedTerm.name: time to value
hasDefinedTerm.description: How long it takes a new user to reach that first meaningful outcome.

hasDefinedTerm.name: API
hasDefinedTerm.description: A defined contract letting one system call another programmatically.

hasDefinedTerm.name: REST
hasDefinedTerm.description: An API style using standard HTTP verbs against resource URLs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GraphQL
hasDefinedTerm.description: A query language letting a client request exactly the fields it needs in one round trip.

hasDefinedTerm.name: webhook
hasDefinedTerm.description: An outbound HTTP callback fired when an event occurs, so consumers do not have to poll.

hasDefinedTerm.name: rate limit
hasDefinedTerm.description: A cap on how many requests a client may make in a window.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SDK
hasDefinedTerm.description: A language-specific library wrapping an API so developers do not hand-roll requests.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SSO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Authenticating once against an identity provider to access multiple applications.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SOC 2
hasDefinedTerm.description: An audit report on security and availability controls. Frequently required in enterprise procurement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: uptime SLA
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contractual availability commitment, usually with credits owed when it is missed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: documentation site
hasDefinedTerm.description: The reference and guide content developers rely on. Often a product's highest-intent organic traffic.

hasDefinedTerm.name: changelog
hasDefinedTerm.description: A dated record of releases and changes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: self-serve
hasDefinedTerm.description: A purchase path a customer completes without talking to sales.

hasDefinedTerm.name: expansion revenue
hasDefinedTerm.description: Additional revenue from existing customers through upgrades, seats, or usage.

hasDefinedTerm.name: usage-based pricing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Charging by consumption rather than a flat seat fee.

hasDefinedTerm.name: developer experience
hasDefinedTerm.description: How easily a developer can adopt and succeed with a tool. A genuine differentiator in this category.
